notes: God Siege (Age of War). The God (VR, a giant sun with hands) defends the cube. Everyone else votes in the lobby: Raiders run in with tools to dig at the cube; one Minion Caster (picked at random from those who volunteered) earns money and sends unit waves. Raiders + Caster win by destroying every Core voxel; the God wins by surviving until the timer runs out. The God's skills are gestures: throw them (trigger), push a charged Sun Wave from both hands, clap for Lazy Clouds, grab anything with grip. Tuned with Tools/balance_sim.py siege.

skills.name: Divine Grip
skills.desc: Grip near anything (units or Raiders) to pick it up; let go to throw it. Swat with an open hand; slam down to squash.

skills.name: Zeus Bolt
skills.desc: Throw a lightning bolt: it strikes where it lands.

skills.name: Sun Bomb
skills.desc: Throw a little sun that bursts on impact and sends everyone flying.

skills.name: Hail of Blades
skills.desc: Fling a fan of ten glowing blades that cut through units.

skills.name: Sun Wave
skills.desc: Hands together, hold both triggers to charge, push forward to fire a beam of sunlight.

skills.name: Bubble Ward
skills.desc: Throw a bubble: where it lands, a glass ward blocks all voxel damage.

skills.name: Spring Bloom
skills.desc: Throw a seed: missing outer voxels regrow where it lands (never Core).

skills.name: Comet Drop
skills.desc: Throw a comet. Huge area damage to units (not your cube).

skills.name: Lazy Clouds
skills.desc: Clap your hands: all enemy units move and attack at 40% speed.

units.name: Smiley Scrapper
units.desc: Cheap swarmer that chips the crust.

units.name: Wink Bomber
units.desc: Runs at the cube and pops. Throw it back at its friends.

units.name: Block Brute
units.desc: Tanky smasher. Costs triple mana to grab.

units.name: Cannon Cart
units.desc: Lobs explosive shells from long range.

units.name: Mega Buddy
units.desc: Boss. Can only be grabbed below 30% HP.
